definitions.explanation: A ratio or price at which one thing is exchanged for another, especially currency exchange rates. Also used more broadly for rates in finance and pricing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{為替|かわせ}レート⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
⟦{円安|えんやす}→円安：04854_enyasu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧レート⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}く→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The rate got worse due to the weak yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{両替所|りょうがえじょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧レート⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧⟦{良|よ}くない→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{市内|しない}→市内：20934_shinai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{両替|りょうがえ}→両替：03680_ryougae⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Airport exchange counters don't have great rates, so it's better to exchange money in the city.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used in the context of currency exchange ({為替|かわせ}レート). The word is also used in gaming contexts to refer to win rates or rankings.

The native Japanese equivalent ⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ is used in compounds like ⟦{利率|りりつ}→利率：21159_riritsu⟧ (interest rate) and ⟦{税率|ぜいりつ}→税率：28616_zeiritsu⟧ (tax rate), while レート is preferred for exchange rates and informal rate discussions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {為替|かわせ}レート: exchange rate
- レート⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{良|い}い/⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: the rate is good/bad
- レート⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check the rate
- ⟦{固定|こてい}→固定：10996_kotei⟧レート: fixed rate
